name: print-social-about-me-slide-script-and-sticker
title: About-me slide with script greeting, sticker title and greyscale portrait
whatItIs: A cream slide with dark chocolate text. A rounded greyscale portrait has a bubbly 'about me' sticker label overlapping its corner and an asterisk sticker. To the right a flowing script greeting, a paragraph, and star-bulleted specialisations; below are three columns for Experience, Skills and Contacts with icon bullets.
whatItMeans: Warm, personal and organised, like a well-designed CV page.
techniques: Use a script font for the greeting and a clean sans for information.
Overlap a sticker-style label with a portrait corner.
Use one dark brown on cream for the whole palette.
Organise details in three tidy columns at the base.

vocabulary.definition: A bubbly title with outline placed like a sticker.
A base row splitting info into equal columns.
A four-point star used as a list marker.
